calculations.name: CAGR (%)
calculations.description: Compound Annual Growth Rate computed from Total Premium Paid to Maturity Amount over Tenure (Years). Returns blank if initial value or years are not positive.

expressions.dax:
VAR InitialValue = SUM('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Total Premium Paid])
 VAR FinalValue = SUM('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Maturity Amount])
 VAR Years = MAX('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Tenure (Years)])

 RETURN
 IF(InitialValue>0 && Years>0,
 (POWER(DIVIDE(FinalValue,InitialValue,0), 1/Years)-1),BLANK())

calculations.name: Annual Amount Growth
calculations.description: Annual amount growth computed as Profit / Gain divided by Tenure (Years).

calculations.name: Annual ROI
calculations.description: Annual return on investment: Annual Amount Growth divided by Total Annual Premium.

expressions.dax: DIVIDE([Annual Amount Growth], SUM('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Total Annual Premium]))

calculations.name: Annual Growth Rate Fixed
calculations.description: Annual growth rate (fixed) computed as Annual Amount Growth divided by Total Annual Premium with zero safe divide.

expressions.dax: DIVIDE([Annual Amount Growth],SUM('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Total Annual Premium]),0)

calculations.name: % Premium Paid
calculations.description: Percentage of premium paid = Total Premium_Paid / Total Premium_Amount (safe divide).

calculations.name: % Premium Payable
calculations.description: Percentage of premium payable = Total Premium_Payable / Total Premium_Amount (safe divide).

technical_summary:
Executive summary — Tru Secure CreDebit Dashboard

Purpose and scope
- Provides a consolidated, executive-level view of the life-insurance portfolio to monitor sales, premium collections, policy maturities and product profitability.  
- Integrates customer, agent, policy, product and regional hierarchies to support cross‑functional decision-making across Sales, Underwriting, Finance and Regional Management.

Data and business entities
- Customer dimension: demographics and attributes used for segmentation (gender, age at entry, occupation, smoker status, state).  
- Sales/agent and management hierarchies: agent, zonal and regional manager listings and territory mappings for performance accountability.  
- Product references: policy types and protection plans to compare product performance.  
- Policy fact records: policy-level financials (premium amounts, sum assured, maturity, underwriting expense, tenure, payment frequency and loan exposure) and key dates (purchase, start, last-paid, anniversary, tenure).

Primary KPIs and metrics tracked
- Total Annual Premium and Total Premium (amount) — measures of recurring revenue and upfront receipts.  
- Total Premium Paid, Total Premium Payable and % Premium Paid/Payable — collection efficiency and outstanding premium exposure.  
- Underwriting expense — cost of risk assessment and issuance.  
- Maturity Amount, Profit/Gain, Total Premium Paid — lifetime value and realized returns by policy.  
- Annualized ROI and Annual Growth Rate / CAGR (%) — product and portfolio returns on invested premiums over tenure.  
- Loan Amount Allowed / Loan Eligible — on‑balance credit exposure against policies.  
- Tenure-based indicators (matures in 5/10/15/20 years) and payment buckets — support future cash‑flow and maturity forecasting.

Key business questions the report answers
- Which products and policy types drive the highest annual premium and premium volume?  
- How effective is premium collection (paid vs payable) by product, agent, state and tenure?  
- Which agents, zones and regions contribute most to revenue and where are gaps in collections or profitability?  
- How do underwriting expenses affect product returns and profitability?  
- What are maturity schedules and expected future payouts (short- and medium-term horizons)?  
- What is the ROI profile of the portfolio and how does it vary by tenure, product and customer segments?  
- Where is loan exposure concentrated and which policies are loan-eligible?

How the report supports decision‑making
- Rapid executive oversight: summary KPI cards surface top-line figures for premium, collections, payables and underwriting cost for immediate action.  
- Product and sales optimization: product-level pie/donut and treemap views highlight high-value products and agent contributions to support pricing, incentive and cross‑sell decisions.  
- Regional and agent management: hierarchy and pivot views enable performance reviews, territory reassignments and targeted coaching.  
- Collection and cash‑flow management: time series and tenure-focused visuals expose trends in premium paid vs payable and upcoming maturities to prioritize collection efforts and liquidity planning.  
- Profitability and investment decisions: ROI, CAGR and profit/gain metrics help evaluate product economics and guide strategic allocation between product lines.  
- Underwriting control: monitoring underwriting expense and its impact on returns supports cost-control, process improvements and underwriting policy changes.

Report structure and user interactions
- Summary page: executive KPI cards and a combined customer-policy detail table for rapid drill-down.  
- Insurance Overview: product, agent, state and occupation breakdowns; annual trend of Total Annual Premium for portfolio-level trend analysis.  
- Investment Amount vs Maturity Amount: compares invested premiums (Total Premium Amount) to maturity payouts and tracks annualized ROI over time.  
- Annual Premium vs Protection Value: aligns premiums, sum assured and ROI across tenure cohorts to assess protection density and capital efficiency.  
- Premium Analysis (5–20 years): focused analysis for medium- to long-tenure policies including % Premium Paid / Payable and tenure-based trends.  
- Sales Hierarchy: multi-level pivot and charting to evaluate zonal → regional → agent performance and product mix by territory.  
- Interactive filters (policy name/type, agent, year, state, occupation, tenure/payment bucket) enable flexible, role‑specific exploration.

Operational and strategic outcomes enabled
- Faster, evidence-based allocation of sales incentives and field resources to high-performing agents and regions.  
- Prioritized collections and retention activities informed by payable exposures and upcoming maturities.  
- Product portfolio adjustments guided by profitability and ROI comparisons.  
- Improved forecasting of maturity liabilities and premium cash flows to support capital planning.  
- Better control of underwriting costs and informed underwriting policy changes to improve margins.

Recommendations / next steps
- Use the Sales Hierarchy and pivot outputs in regular regional performance reviews and monthly MI packs.  
- Focus immediate collection efforts on product/region combinations with high premium payable and low % premium paid.  
- Leverage CAGR/ROI insights to re-evaluate product pricing, tenure mix and marketing focus.  
- Consider adding a prioritized alert layer (e.g., high‑value policies approaching maturity or large unpaid premiums) to operationalize next‑step actions.

This dashboard converts policy-level finance and sales data into actionable insights that support revenue optimization, risk and cost control, and strategic portfolio decisions across the organization.
